## Problem and resulting behaviour

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for the user.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Include screenshots for UI changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] Target is `develop`, or this is a `develop` → `preview` / `preview` → `main` promotion.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed; limitations or skipped checks are explained.
- [ ] English and German translations updated where needed.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, local documentation or model weights added.
- [ ] Applicable third-party licenses and notices preserved.
